column1: The COCOMO-81 dataset is used for software effort estimation based on the COCOMO (Constructive Cost Model) developed by Barry Boehm in 1981. It is widely used in software engineering research to predict the effort required to develop software projects based on various project attributes.
The dataset contains historical software project data including size
- Machine learning applications in software engineering
- Comparing predictive models such as Decision Trees and Random Forests
Common Features (may vary depending on version of dataset):
- Numeric and categorical features (depending on encoding)
- Often used for benchmarking machine learning models
Some versions of the dataset may contain missing or encoded categorical values that require preprocessing before model training.
- Normalize or standardize features (optional for tree-based models)
- Split dataset into training and testing sets
- COCOMO Model: Constructive Cost Estimation Model
